changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLES] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'GenericCommand') begin CREATE TABLE [dbo].[GenericCommand] ( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Description] [varchar](500) NOT NULL, [CommandText] [varchar](max) NOT NULL, [CommandTimeout] [int] NULL, [EnvironmentsLimitJson] varchar(50) NULL, [ClientsLimitJson] varchar(500) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_GenericCommand] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS(select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLES] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'GenericCommand') begin DROP TABLE [dbo].[GenericCommand]; end
